name: amazon-research-outreach
description: AI-powered Amazon product research, seller contact research and B2B outreach SaaS

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @app/api -w @app/worker -w @app/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @app/api" "npm run dev -w @app/worker" "npm run dev -w @app/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run start -w @app/api" "npm run start -w @app/worker" "npm run start -w @app/web"
scripts.start:fresh: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @app/shared -w @app/core -w @app/agents -w @app/api -w @app/web
